g.text: (b) Signal of an atmosphere in transmission
Scale height H = kT/(μ m_H g) with T = equilibrium temperature; feature ≈ 2·5H·R_p/R_*². Planet and star data: NASA Exoplanet Archive; μ = 2.3 (H₂) or 28–29 (N₂-rich) assumed.
